claims.content: The Customer clicks the very large “Register Now” button in the New User registration section, which takes the user to Registration Page 1.
Registration Page 1 collects the minimum required information in order to create an account, collect payment, and place bids (the “short process”).
The Customer completes the short registration process.

Completing the short registration process triggers an automated “transactional” email, with a Thank You message for registering, and telling the customer to enable cookies, and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list, or address book/contact list.

1. If a NEW customer matches the Consumer Protection negative file while trying to create a new JTVauctions.com account, the registrant receives the message: “We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time.” Exit: The new account cannot be successfully established; the use case ends in failure.

2. If a registrant tries to create a new account using an existing email address, the system generates a response notifying the registrant that the email address is already in use and asks whether the registrant needs to reset the password for that account. If the user indicates “yes”, the system generates an email to the email address with a temporary password that the user should be advised to change. Exit: No two accounts may use the same email address, so the duplicate new account is not created.

3. If an account already exists for a customer with this name and address, the system informs the customer that an account already exists and offers to send sign in information to the email address on file for that account. Exit: The registration attempt is replaced by the offer to send sign in information for the existing account.
The NEW JTVauctions.com account is successfully established.
The Consumer Protection negative file has been cross-referenced before the NEW account is successfully established.
The Customer has read and agreed to the Terms of Use Agreement by checking the Terms of Use checkbox.
The Customer has completed the short registration process.

A registration (account setup) confirmation email is sent to the Customer, including a “Welcome and Thank You” message using the customer’s real name and the statement “You are now registered with JTV Auctions!”.

The registration confirmation email includes instructions on how to add JTV Auctions email addresses to the user’s whitelist or safe senders list, and includes a request or subscriber form for the Auction Insider Newsletter.
The Customer is now a registered user; only registered users may use the auction site, and there is no Guest Checkout.
